content.comment_body: Hello, I have an application where I need to count pulses on 4 separate inputs. Each input pulse rate is about 5000 pulses per minute (approximately 83 Hz). Is it possible to handle this with [product_name] without using high-speed counter inputs? I look forward to your feedback. Best regards, [user_name]

Hi, If you want to use regular inputs, you'll need to test whether it works in your case. It depends on the scan time of [product_name], which is influenced by your program. Check the [product_name] manual; there's a method described to determine the scan time. I recommend trying the newer [product_name] [article_no], which provides 4 high-speed inputs. I hope this helps. Regards, [user_name]
Thank you for your response. I will give it a try.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are discussing whether [product_name] can reliably count pulses at approximately 83 Hz on four channels using standard inputs instead of high-speed counter inputs. There are concerns about the device's scan time limitations, and a suggestion to use a newer model with dedicated high-speed inputs highlights a gap between standard device functionality and users' needs for accurately counting quick pulses.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects [product_name] to accurately count pulses exceeding 80 Hz on normal inputs, without requiring specialized high-speed counter inputs.
